# Original test font

`wide.ttf` is an original Folio fixture under the repository's BSD-2-Clause license. It contains a blank space and one rectangular glyph shared by printable ASCII characters, with a 1200-unit advance at 1000 units per em. It has no third-party outlines or font data. It was assembled using fontTools FontBuilder to make delayed font loading change wrapping predictably across platforms.
